card.name: Decimal points and digits in number comparisons
card.fires_on: The decimal point or a digit inside a written decimal number, or the word hundred before 'th' when rounding volumes. It appears where decimal places are being compared or rounded.

modes.label: Decimal point in comparisons

modes.label: Rounding to hundredth
modes.description: The word hundred in 'nearest hundredth' when rounding a dose volume in mL.
modes.example: Round volume to the nearest<< hundred>>th mL.

card.writes: It suppresses decimal-related words such as decimal, decimals and digits, so it holds back talk of decimal places.
card.plain: It fires on the decimal point or digits in numbers being compared or rounded, and it lowers the chance of the model saying 'decimal' next.
